vacancy.title: Team Leader AIT
vacancy.assessment: Permanent Airbus Netherlands Team Leader for Assembly, Integration & Testing, leading 10–15 people and overseeing production/test resources, process improvement and facilities in Leiden. User's 10+ years of mechanical engineering and machine-project leadership plus MBO–HBO–MSc progression fit the cross-level communication and hardware aspects. Main stretch is direct people management of 10–15 staff and spacecraft AIT domain experience; not a direct ESTEC placement, and salary relative to €70k target is unconfirmed. Official role requests MBO/HBO technical degree and 2–5+ years as team leader/supervisor/project lead.
